rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or round of voting.

example.english: This ballot will be held on Sunday.
example.traditional: 今次投票會喺星期日舉行。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 tau4 piu3 wui5 hai2 sing1 kei4 jat6 geoi2 hang4

rows.note: Use this for the ballot paper or slip itself, rather than the act of voting.

example.english: You have to fill in the ballot before you can vote.
example.traditional: 你填好張選票，先至可以投票。
example.jyutping: nei5 tin4 hou2 zoeng1 syun2 piu3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 tau4 piu3
